measurement_basis: committed baseline source and content-integrity-verified repository-owner audit records

outcome.baseline_projection_capability: The implementation-accountability projection exposed owner-declared surfaces, plain host-responsibility summaries, and verified source pointers, but its per-source audit detail omitted canonical MNCS surfaces and the pressure identities recorded by each repository owner.
outcome.source_evidence: The exact mncs-actions and mncs-test native-userland-audit.json records list canonical native surfaces and source-declared pressure identities. The parent Environmental observation also points to mncs-test P-004 and P-006 pressure records; their content integrity is separately represented by the existing source pointer projection.
outcome.actionable_opportunity: Expose bounded canonical-surface and existing-pressure lists from the exact verified audit blobs so agents can move from a remaining host responsibility to the native surfaces and pressure records its owner named.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The lists remain owner declarations. A pressure identity string does not establish that every named pressure record is present, verified, or causally blocks a migration. The audit sample does not establish a complete adoption denominator.
outcome.recurrence: One campaign evidence path; recurrence across independent sessions is not established.

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Native surfaces and source-declared pressure links were omitted from owner-audit details
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment implementation accountability and native-userland source projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The committed fb37382 baseline exposes each audit's source pointer and summary but not the canonical_mncs_surfaces or existing_pressures fields in the verified owner-audit source records. This is a projection coverage gap established from source and campaign evidence, not evidence that another agent failed to discover the information.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Add bounded, explicitly owner-declared canonical-surface and pressure-identity fields to the existing projection, keep exact source pointers visible, and do not promote pressure strings into verified causal claims.
